name: Isihlambezo, umhlabelo and imbiza in pregnancy and infancy
what_people_do: Zulu women take isihlambezo during pregnancy, umhlabelo for postpartum recovery and imbiza for babies.
why_they_say_it_works: To keep pregnancy healthy, speed recovery and protect the baby; passed down and used alongside free clinics.

documented_by.source: Ramulondi M et al 2022, Afr J Reprod Health, PMID 37585018
documented_by.quote_or_summary: Northern KwaZulu-Natal, 140 women: 79% used traditional medicine in childbearing despite free healthcare.

evidence.finding: No safety or efficacy study read; the survey asks health workers to be aware.

source.name: agent4-traditional-practices.md, 12 Nov 2026 (research file in this project)

harm_note: Contents vary by healer; nothing opened quantifies harm.
